arxiv-2104-01389.title: MIEZE Neutron Spin-Echo Spectroscopy of Strongly Correlated Electron Systems
arxiv-2104-01389.creator: Christian Franz 1, Steffen Säubert 2, Andreas Wendl 2, Franz X. Haslbeck 2,3, Olaf Soltwedel 2,4, Johanna K. Jochum 1, Leonie Spitz 2, Jonas Kindervater 2, Andreas Bauer 2, Peter Böni 2, and Christian Pfleiderer 2
arxiv-2104-01389.description: Abstract Recent progress in neutron spin-echo spectroscopy by means of longitudinal Modulation of IntEnsity with Zero Effort (MIEZE) is reviewed. Key technical characteristics are summarized which highlight that the parameter range accessible in momentum and energy, as well as its limitations, are extremely well understood and controlled.

arxiv-2106-05185.title: Demonstration of electron-nuclear decoupling at a spin clock transition
arxiv-2106-05185.creator: Krishnendu Kundu, 1 Jia Chen, 2,3,4 Silas Hoffman, 2,3,4 Jonathan Marbey, 1,4,5 Dorsa Komijani, 1,5 Yan Duan, 6 Alejandro Gaita-Ariño, 6 John Stanton, 3,4,7 Xiao-Guang Zhang, 2,3,4 Hai-Ping Cheng, 2,3,4 Stephen Hill 1,4,5
arxiv-2106-05185.description: Abstract The ability to design quantum systems that decouple from environmental noise sources is highly desirable for development of quantum technologies with optimal coherence. The chemical tunability of electronic states in magnetic molecules combined with advanced electron spin resonance techniques provides excellent opportunities to address this problem.

arxiv-2110-07267.title: The role of density in the energy conservation for the isentropic compressible Euler equations
arxiv-2110-07267.creator: Yanqing Wang Yulin Ye, Huan Yu
arxiv-2110-07267.description: Abstract In this paper, we study Onsager’s conjecture on the energy conservation for the isentropic compressible Euler equations via establishing the energy conservation criterion involving the density ϱ ∈ L k ​ ( 0 , T , L l ​ ( 𝕋 d ) ) \varrho\in L^{k}(0,T;L^{l}(\mathbb{T}^{d})) .

arxiv-2309-13158.title: Size and Albedo Constraints for (152830) Dinkinesh Using WISE Data
arxiv-2309-13158.creator: Kiana D. McFadden, Amy K. Mainzer, Joseph R. Masiero, James M. Bauer, Roc M. Cutri, Dar Dahlen, Frank J. Masci, Jana Pittichová, Akash Satpathy, Edward L. Wright
arxiv-2309-13158.description: Abstract Probing small main-belt asteroids provides insight into their formation and evolution through multiple dynamical and collisional processes. These asteroids also overlap in size with the potentially hazardous near-earth object population and supply the majority of these objects. The Lucy mission will provide an opportunity for study of a small main-belt asteroid, (152830) Dinkinesh.

arxiv-2404-08008.title: Sample-Efficient Human Evaluation of Large Language Models via Maximum Discrepancy Competition
arxiv-2404-08008.creator: Kehua Feng, Keyan Ding, Hongzhi Tan, Kede Ma, Zhihua Wang, Shuangquan Guo, Yuzhou Cheng, Ge Sun, Guozhou Zheng, Qiang Zhang, Huajun Chen
arxiv-2404-08008.description: Abstract Reliable evaluation of large language models (LLMs) is impeded by two key challenges: objective metrics often fail to reflect human perception of natural language, and exhaustive human labeling is prohibitively expensive. Here, we propose a sample-efficient human evaluation method for LLMs based on the principle of MAximum Discrepancy (MAD) Competition.

arxiv-2502-00436.title: Secure Data Reconstruction: A Direct Data-Driven Approach
arxiv-2502-00436.creator: Jiaqi Yan, Ivan Markovsky, John Lygeros
arxiv-2502-00436.description: Abstract This paper addresses the problem of secure data reconstruction for unknown systems, where data collected from the system are susceptible to malicious manipulation. We aim to recover the real trajectory without prior knowledge of the system model. To achieve this, a behavioral language is used to represent the system, describing it using input/output trajectories instead of state-space models.

arxiv-2503-20479.title: A multi-agentic framework for real-time, autonomous freeform metasurface design
arxiv-2503-20479.creator: Robert Lupoiu, Yixuan Shao, Tianxiang Dai, Chenkai Mao, Kofi Edée, Jonathan A. Fan
arxiv-2503-20479.description: Abstract Innovation in nanophotonics currently relies on human experts who synergize specialized knowledge in photonics and coding with simulation and optimization algorithms, entailing design cycles that are time-consuming, computationally demanding, and frequently suboptimal. We introduce MetaChat, a multi-agentic design framework that can translate semantically described photonic design goals into high-performance, freeform device layouts in an automated, nearly real-time manner.

arxiv-2505-22457.title: Fostering Video Reasoning via Next-Event Prediction Thanks: Equal contribution. Work done during Haonan Wang and Hongfu Liu’s internships at Sea AI Lab. Thanks: Correspondence to Tianyu Pang.
arxiv-2505-22457.creator: Haonan Wang Hongfu Liu Xiangyan Liu, Chao Du Kenji Kawaguchi Ye Wang Tianyu Pang
arxiv-2505-22457.description: Abstract Next-token prediction serves as the foundational learning task enabling reasoning in LLMs. But what should the learning task be when aiming to equip MLLMs with temporal reasoning capabilities over video inputs? Existing tasks such as video question answering often rely on annotations from humans or much stronger MLLMs, while video captioning tends to entangle temporal reasoning with spatial information.

pmc-11616435.creator: Parimala Vijai Indrian, Wei Wen Chong, Anizah Ali, Adliah Mhd Ali
pmc-11616435.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe patient-centred counselling tools are a comprehensive resource to assist community pharmacists in providing effective treatment choices and assisting with decision-making.AimTo identify and select suitable tools community pharmacists use with targeted patient-centred outcomes for dispensing contraceptives.MethodsFive electronic databases, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar as additional sources for published and unpublished studies, were searched to identify literature for contraceptive tools or strategies for pharmacists to decide on contraceptive choice and dispensing by pharmacist.

pmc-12522265.title: BayesianFitForecast: a user-friendly R toolbox for parameter estimation and forecasting with ordinary differential equations
pmc-12522265.creator: Hamed Karami, Amanda Bleichrodt, Ruiyan Luo, Gerardo Chowell
pmc-12522265.description: BackgroundMathematical models based on ordinary differential equations (ODEs) are essential tools across various scientific disciplines, including biology, ecology, epidemic modeling, and healthcare informatics, where they are used to simulate complex dynamic systems and inform decision-making. However, implementing Bayesian calibration and forecasting typically requires substantial coding in Stan or similar tools.

pmc-12607489.title: Personalized Damage Assessment in Aesthetic Surgery: Current Trends and the Italian Scenario
pmc-12607489.creator: Federico Amadei, Domenico Tripodi, Claudio Cannistrà, Felice Moccia, Marcello Molle, Mario Faenza, Giuseppe Basile, Luk Hsiang Ning
pmc-12607489.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Introduction: Aesthetic surgery addresses subjective desires for morphological enhancement and differs from reconstructive surgery due to its elective, non-therapeutic nature. This distinction introduces complex medico-legal challenges, particularly concerning informed consent, patient expectations, and the legal evaluation of aesthetic damage. Materials and Methods: A narrative review was conducted using national legislation, Italian and international clinical guidelines, peer-reviewed literature from PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science, and Italian Supreme Court rulings.

pmc-12816940.title: The effects of neuromodulation interventions on the eating behaviors of patients with eating disorders compared to healthy controls, sham therapies, and other therapeutic approaches: A systematic review
pmc-12816940.creator: Evangelia Tsapakis, Efi Karakosta, Apostolos Karapatis, Anysia Papazoglou, Michael Treiber, Konstantinos N. Fountoulakis
pmc-12816940.description: BackgroundStandard treatments for eating disorders (EDs) typically include nutritional rehabilitation, psychotherapy, and pharmacotherapy, often resulting in modest effectiveness. Neuromodulation has been proposed as a potential add-on strategy. This review aims to critically evaluate its effects on EDs.MethodsThe PICO framework was used to conduct a search according to the PRISMA guidelines for systematic reviews (PROSPERO Registration no. CRD42024559700).

pmc-13180822.title: Liberation mathematics I: the behavioral and consciousness definition of perpetual self-transcendence
pmc-13180822.creator: Swapan Samanta
pmc-13180822.description: Traditional definitions of liberation (such as moksha, nirvana, and kaivalya) across Hindu, Buddhist, and Jain philosophical traditions have remained empirically underspecified and conceptually divergent for over 2,500 years. This study proposes an operational definition of liberation asperpetual self-transcendence through infinite domain expansion, characterized by the inability to fix one’s identity in any achieved position.

pmc-13257917.title: Recurrence of Non-Melanoma Skin Cancers in the Head and Neck Area—A Single-Center Retrospective Analysis
pmc-13257917.creator: Monika Wojarska, Karol Mitas, Paulina Bernecka, Maria Gac, Amelia Maria Glinko, Samira Kierat, Gabriela Ratajczyk, Marija Turek, Adrianna Włoch, Krzysztof Pastuszak, Jerzy Jankau
pmc-13257917.description: Background: Non-melanoma skin cancers (NMSCs) of the head and neck represent a therapeutic challenge due to the region’s complex anatomy, functional considerations, and frequent involvement of high-risk anatomical zones. Local recurrence remains a clinically significant concern, however real-world data regarding recurrence patterns and associated risk factors in facial NMSCs are limited.

uslaw-usc-t40-s623.title: 40 U.S.C. § 623 — Establishment of a Federal Real Property Council
uslaw-usc-t40-s623.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t40-s623.description: United States Code, Title 40 (Public Buildings, Property, And Works); Chapter 5 (Property Management); Subchapter VII (Property Management). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment.— There is established a Federal Real Property Council. (b) Purpose.— The purpose of the Council shall be— (1) to develop guidance and ensure implementation of an efficient and effective real property management strategy; (2) to identify opportunities.
